authority: User agreed to the three execution diagnoses after discussing overly strict G0-G9 application.
method: Review current register and the six linked public-summary packets, not fresh advertisements. No accepted market input or fair-value interval is manufactured. Historical admission dispositions remain dated facts; new policy alone does not revalidate them.
